study type: Critical Appraisal / Systematic Review of existing studies (RCTs, meta-analyses, observational studies)
cohort: The studies reviewed in this appraisal involve pregnant women and their fetuses undergoing intrapartum monitoring.
finding: The latest meta-analysis demonstrated a significant reduction of metabolic acidosis rates by 36% and operative vaginal delivery rates by 8% when using fetal electrocardiogram ST waveform analysis compared with cardiotocography alone.
mod_finding: The latest meta-analysis showed a significant 8% reduction in operative vaginal delivery rates with fetal electrocardiogram ST waveform analysis compared to cardiotocography alone.
